children: Children's publishing and education firm's fiscal Q1 revenue fell 4% yr/yr
Adjusted loss per share widened yr/yr in fiscal Q1
Company repurchased $25.8 mln in shares during the quarter
Scholastic affirms fiscal 2027 revenue growth guidance of approximately 2% to 4%
Company expects fiscal 2027 Adjusted EBITDA of about $135 mln to $145 mln
Scholastic continues to expect fiscal 2027 free cash flow of about $35 mln to $40 mln
EDUCATION PRESSURE - Co said lower Education revenues reflected continued pressure on school and district funding and spending on supplemental curriculum materials
BOOK PUBLISHING DECLINE - Co said Children's Book Publishing and Distribution revenues fell due to lower Book Fairs and Trade sales, with prior-year international co-edition sales not recurring
ENTERTAINMENT GROWTH - Co said Entertainment revenues rose due to higher production revenues
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the consumer publishing peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Scholastic Corporation is $42.00, about 18.8% above its September 23 closing price of $35.36
The stock recently traded at 19 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 17 three months ago
